data.title: VPN/Proxy Login Anomaly — Astrill or Residential Proxy
data.description: Detects corporate VPN authentication events originating from known Astrill VPN infrastructure, residential proxy services, or connection patterns indicating VPN-over-VPN layering. DPRK IT workers route connections through Astrill VPN to U.S.-based proxy laptops before connecting to corporate infrastructure, creating a characteristic multi-hop pattern with elevated latency and IP reputation indicators.

detection.condition: selection and (filter_astrill or filter_residential_proxy or filter_vpn_layering)

enrichment_required.source: Network path analysis enrichment (traceroute or proxy-chain detection)
VPN/proxy provider lookup (e.g., Spur, IPinfo privacy detection)

falsepositives: Employees in countries where VPN use is required for internet access
Employees using personal VPN services for privacy while on public networks
